# activedirectory_gmsa (Data Source)

Look up a group Managed Service Account (gMSA) by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName. Errors if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single gMSA by GUID, DN, SID, or sAMAccountName. Exactly one
# identity attribute must be set; the lookup errors if the gMSA is absent.
data "activedirectory_gmsa" "web01" {
  sam_account_name = "svc-web01"
}

output "web01_dns_hostname" {
  value = data.activedirectory_gmsa.web01.dns_hostname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dn` (String) Look the object up by distinguished name.
- `guid` (String) Look the object up by objectGUID.
- `sam_account_name` (String) Look the object up by sAMAccountName.
- `sid` (String) Look the object up by security identifier.

### Read-Only

- `account_expiration_date` (String) Account expiry (RFC 3339), or "" if it never expires.
- `container` (String) Distinguished name of the parent.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `display_name` (String) The name shown in address lists.
- `dns_hostname` (String) The FQDN associated with this account's default service principal names.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is enabled.
- `id` (String) The objectGUID.
- `kerberos_encryption_type` (Set of String) The Kerberos encryption types the account supports.
- `managed_password_interval_in_days` (Number) How often Active Directory rotates the managed password, in days.
- `name` (String) The CN.
- `principals_allowed_to_retrieve_managed_password` (Set of String) The objectGUIDs of the computers or groups allowed to retrieve this account's managed password.
- `service_principal_names` (Set of String) The account's service principal names.
- `trusted_for_delegation` (Boolean) Whether the account is trusted for Kerberos delegation.
